core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix organic earthy elements with high-density data visualization.
Emotion First: The platform should feel grounded, calm, and trustworthy, avoiding cold corporate SaaS aesthetics.
Negative Space: Generous spacing to create breathing room around complex educational data.
Contrast: Use rough vs. smooth, bold terracotta accents against calm bone-white backgrounds.

anti_patterns: No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
No default bolding for everything; use weight contrast (e.g., Light vs ExtraBold).

rules: Never use pure black or pure gray. Always tint neutral greys with warm tones.
DO NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4).

layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.bento_grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid for overview/marketing sections. gap-8 to gap-12.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy (Tailwind Scale: p-4 to p-12). Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and headings. Use optical alignment over geometric.
layouts.mobile_constraints: Mobile-first responsive. Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile.

surface_strategies.cards: Neumorphism Tactile Variant: Flat background matching parent, 1px subtle border (border-border), no default shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/70 with 1px delicate inner stroke. Never fully transparent.
surface_strategies.interactive: Must explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have higher contrast with focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/50.

motion.hover: Subtle translate and shadow expansion (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items and cards in the dashboard.

components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn chart components with earthy palette colors.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or subtle rounded (rounded-lg). Only use primary color for main CTAs.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Form. Left-aligned labels.
components.navigation: Visible sidebar or top nav with clear branding, user avatar, and active states.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay on main background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) for a premium, tactile feel.

hero_background.description: Windblown ripples in fine golden sand forming organic flowing patterns

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use Text Shadow over images.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-lesson-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment and generous spacing.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions; use Shadcn UI.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all buttons, links, and forms.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for headers or sticky elements; use the defined crystal glass style.
Implement a Socratic AI Tutor interface and a Study Path Planner dashboard.
Do not center align the app container in CSS.
Never use placeholder images from dummy services, use only provided image_urls.
Add transition properties explicitly to interactive elements; avoid 'transition: all'.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth through layered design and z-index hierarchy.
Do not make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
